siki.voice_description: An adult owl storyteller. Warm, precise, quietly curious. Rounded resonance, clear consonants, restrained theatricality, measured pacing. A distinctive speaking voice — not a hoot, not a celebrity imitation.

alt_batch._note: siki_4/5/6 = female, South African-accented owl storyteller (design call 2026-11-12); audition text ~500 chars covering ack/explain/name/number/urgent/quiet beats
alt_batch.voice_description: An adult owl storyteller with a distinctly South African accent — soft, precise consonants with a gentle melodic lilt. Female voice, warm, quietly curious, measured pacing, clear diction. Restrained theatricality, never cartoonish, a distinctive speaking voice — not a celebrity imitation.

batch2._note: siki_7/8/9 = stronger African/South African direction after batch-1 accents read too subtle; description pushed 'deep unmistakable South African accent, resonant alto, melodic African lilt'
batch2.voice_description: An adult African woman storyteller with a deep, unmistakable South African accent — rich rounded vowels, warm resonant alto timbre, melodic African lilt, strong clear consonants. Female voice, quietly curious, measured and deliberate pacing, warm and wise. A distinctive speaking voice with real African character — not a generic narrator, not a celebrity imitation.

zana.voice_description: An adult dog enforcer. Compact, mid-to-low register. Direct consonants, short dry phrases, streetwise, controlled impatience with occasional unguarded warmth. Assertive, never cartoonish, clearly contrasted with a warm narrator.
